faq.q: How many U.S. federal comment periods on "artificial intelligence" are open?
faq.a: As of 2026-09-20, 16 Federal Register documents matching the exact full-text query "artificial intelligence" have open comment periods; 4 of them close within 14 days. 26 matching documents were published in the last 30 days. Source: Federal Register API (public domain).
